_comment: The unstructured DG0 twin of box_diffusive.json: the same 50x50 quad box, ten mean free paths per cell at a scattering ratio of 0.99, only "type": "unstructured" added. The plex DSA's two-point-flux operator is the structured star times the cell volume on this mesh, so the -precon_dsa count pins against the structured one.
